ValidationRule.description: C3 and SC rows need a Sales Channel. WH rows are checked on the Warehouse only (vr_ERS_Classification_WH); their Sales Channel (legacy lookup via Acting_Value__c) is kept filled by hand until part 4.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Classification__c, 'C3' ) ,ISPICKVAL( Classification__c, 'SC' ) ) ,ISBLANK( TEXT(Sales_Channel__c )) )
